rawContent: Ms. Watson organized a sweet cyclist protest in #PDX weeks ago. Turned out to be big and more dynamic than she expected. Great to see riders making it happen from coast to coast. #BlackLivesMatter

But still, I thank @maziehirono and the subcommittee for inviting me to testify.

Now, back at it! We will not stop until the Constitution is made real for Black Americans b/c #BlackLivesMatter.
We said that the #PDXprotests were dress rehearsal for the feds. Sadly, other cities are seeing the truth of it. #PortlandProtests #buildjustice #fightfacism #BlackLivesMatter

Remember all of those wordsmithed #BlackLivesMatter statements that popped up in your email from nearly every company with which you’ve ever made a transaction? “Copy machine company for Black lives... Big bank for BLM...” and such??
2/4

Officials should focus on removing the injustice. Then protestors will go home, where they would rather be. And, more importantly, Black people will finally enjoy our full rights and responsibilities as American citizens, and Oregonians. #BlackLivesMatter isn't a mere slogan.

Good morning, y'all! Take time to reflect on your activism. Sort out the confusion and frustration you're feeling. Please don't ignore those feelings. Address them. Then, you'll be better prepared to keep pushing. #BuildJustice #BlackLivesMatter #DefundThePolice #OregonProtests

Before I go, do y’all remember the backlash against #BlackLivesMatter that I warned of earlier this summer? Basically I said, “Oregon nice” demands the silence of the oppressed and the wronged, and would only tolerate dissonance for a short while. Welp. Here we are. 14/
